headline: Review of Administrative Plan II and 2027 work plan reflection, plus loan portfolio updates and a delinquent loan.
summary: Loan portfolio updates include one delinquent loan, and the agenda ends with other business. The next meeting, on December 7, 2026, will be followed by a fellowship lunch to mark the final meeting of 2026.
items: RLF portfolio updates and delinquent loan
plain_text:
Greater Nashua Revolving Loan Fund (RLF) Committee 
The Greater Nashua Revolving Loan Fund’s mission is to provide flexible, impact-
focused capital through responsible lending practices to small businesses in 
Greater Nashua. Our vision is to preserve and grow jobs and generate economic 
opportunities for all residents in the community. 
 
Meeting Agenda 
Date: November 16, 2026; Time: 12:00 p.m. to 01:30 p.m.  Location: Room 208, 2nd Floor  
1. Welcome and Introductions 
2. Approval of Minutes Review and approval of the October 19, 2026 meeting minutes. 
3. Administrative Plan II Review 
4. 2027 Work Plan Committee Reflection 
5. RLF Portfolio Updates + Delinquent Loan  
6. Others Business 
7. Next Meeting: December 7, 2026 | 12:00–1:30 p.m., followed by a fellowship lunch to mark the 
final meeting of 2026.
